description: Changes the visibility of a page: private (owner only), unlisted (anyone with the link) or public (indexable). unlisted/public expose the page to other people. It also changes the visibility of a daily page (the current day).

slug.description: Page slug/path; hierarchical paths are allowed (e.g. 'briefings/today')

user.description: Page owner username (default: the connected account)

name: outbox_set_visibility
title: Outbox: change page visibility
